Due to a historical right-of-way dispute, no direct transmission corridor exists between Substation Alpha and Substation Beta.
Furthermore, owing to a regulatory mandate concerning grid redundancy, precisely one of the following two corridors must be incorporated into the inspection circuit: the corridor between Substation Beta and Gamma, or the corridor between Substation Gamma and Delta.

The objective is to determine the most efficient inspection circuit that visits every substation precisely a single time, concluding at the point of origin, thereby minimizing the total distance traversed.
